verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents preset work hours and per-link custom hours. It also lets calendar events shape availability, such as a "Demos" event limiting a link's times. Nothing in the pack documents date-specific overrides or out-of-office periods as named features. Missing for 10: documented date overrides, documented out-of-office/vacation periods, named reusable availability schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can define availability schedules with working hours, date overrides, and out-of-office periods

citations.quote: Team members can set custom availability for each round robin scheduling link or default to their preset work hours.
Each host in the rotation can have a priority, their own hours for the link
Budget your time using calendar events, and wire up SavvyCal to honor those preferences.
Put a "Demos" event on your calendar, and your demo link only offers times inside it.
